name: Zoom Paper
desc: AI document editor that drafts, restructures and formats reports.
desc_zh: 能起草、改结构和排版文档的 AI 文档编辑器
solves: A rough draft still costs an evening of formatting. Zoom Paper rewrites and lays out the document, then keeps .docx margins and headers on export.
solves_zh: 初稿写完还要再花一晚上调格式。Zoom Paper 帮你改写和排版，导出 .docx 时页边距、页眉页脚都保留。
best_for: Meeting notes must become a client-ready report before the deadline.
best_for_zh: 会议记录要赶在截止时间前变成一份能发给客户的报告。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.zoom.com/en/products/whats-new/ (product timeline, June 2026), t）。 Launched with the Zoom AI Productivity Suite on 2026-06-01. The product page lives under the AI Productivity Suite path; the URL redirects only to add the trailing slash. The What's New timeline adds that it drafts, restructures, translates and adjusts tone, and keeps .docx formatting on import and export.
